categories.question: You open the curtains at a mountain lodge. Which view do you hope to find?

outcomes.name: A lake reflecting snowy peaks
outcomes.description: Small contained alpine lake with clear inverted reflection of white peaks

outcomes.name: A waterfall in a green ravine
outcomes.description: Slim white waterfall pouring down a lush green alpine ravine

outcomes.name: A meadow dotted with blue gentians
outcomes.description: Sunny mountain meadow carpeted with vivid trumpet-shaped blue gentian flowers

outcomes.name: A rocky ridge above the clouds
outcomes.description: Jagged grey ridge emerging above soft white cloud with a little sunrise glow
